intent: Compare today's ex-VAT total price of items on the old receipt to the receipt's subtotal, answer YES if difference <= 3 EUR else NO.
success_criteria: Receipt file in /uploads/ located via List and read
Subtotal (old_ex) extracted from receipt SUBTOTAL line
Every receipt SKU matched to catalogue product_variants, first exact then fuzzy (0/O, 1/I, 5/S, 8/B, 2/Z interchangeable), discontinued SKUs contribute 0
today_ex computed as SUM(qty * matched price_cents)/100 over all receipt lines
Answer refs contains receipt file path

agents_md_constraints.anchor: # Important things > When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

agents_md_constraints.anchor: # Important things > When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response.
agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response.

answer_template.message: Receipt at {receipt_path}: subtotal (ex VAT) {old_ex} EUR. Today's ex-VAT total would be {today_ex} EUR - difference {diff} EUR, {within} the 3 EUR limit. <YES/NO>
